rationale: The ground-truth thread's core substance is dsocek questioning a narrower naming-conflict workaround and tthakkal responding 'I will remove this change and keep this PR specific to sdxl support' — Y's top finding independently reconstructs exactly this (citing commit ac3a2ce5, the reverted WeightsMapper for to_out.0, and the deleted test), a precise recall hit with hedged, well-evidenced framing. X notices the same revert but asserts it was 'correctly reverted — good call, don't reinstate it,' which mischaracterizes a scope decision as a settled technical non-issue and anchors several other deep, unverifiable extrapolations (FF-layer weight drop, text-encoder hard-fail, CI-red claims) that the actual approving reviewers never raised, softening X's precision despite strong actionable code suggestions. Both lack a LATENT GAP CHECK section.
